scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed efficiently with only 5 tool calls, correctly identifying the error types, scale, frameworks, and concentration in HotReload test files. The main gap is potentially missing FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests as a failing project - the agent only retrieved 20 of 169+ errors and may not have seen all projects. Despite encountering a file-not-found error on the first bash attempt, it recovered gracefully by re-querying with maxResults. The analysis and root cause explanation were clear and well-structured.
